_comment: Local corrections layered over the upstream pool lists by pools-sync.py. Keys: pools (merged by slug; replace=true discards upstream addresses/tags for that slug; pool=true matches before individual miners' addresses), drop (slugs never emitted), generic (tag-only software identifiers matched last so a miner's own tag or address wins). DATUM miners (mempool.guide regex DATUM|datum|Datum) must stay generic: in the tag band it sits ahead of CONVOY/RIPTIDE and steals their DATUM User coinbases. PyBLOCK's LOTTO/CAROUSEL/CHIRP modes are folded into one PyBLOCK entry, as mempool.guide shows them.

pools._comment: Blocks found by a miner on the solo ports. Tag only, never the payout address: the pool's address is in a solo coinbase too, as the fee output, and matching on it would take pooled blocks as well. Ranked ahead of Lazarus because 'Lazarus/solo' contains 'Lazarus'.
pools.name: Lazarus Solo
AlphaPool
pools._comment: AlphaPool's coinbase pays its members, so a member's payout address (richlab) matched before the pool's tag and took the blocks. pool=true puts the tag first. DATUM-AP was its Prime's primary tag from 18 Sep until 22 Sep ~20:18 UTC, after which its blocks carry AlphaPool with each gateway's name as the secondary tag (973724 = AlphaPool/The Mothership). Both eras pay the same 1% fee output to bc1qycx42j0mm2we68g5t8k0ul9sgccha0ewkawedw (9 of 9 blocks checked), which is what ties them together; the lookahead keeps DATUM-AP off a longer name like DATUM-APEX.
